Instructions:
**********************************************************************************************
*                                      Instructions:                                       *
*                                                                                            *
* - You must guess the hidden word.                                                        *
* - You have a limited number of lives (default is 4, you can change this in settings).     *
* - Each time you enter an incorrect letter, you'll lose a life.                           *
* - If you guess the word without losing all your lives, congratulations!                   *
* - If you run out of lives, you lose.                                                     *
* - Have fun!                                                                             *
*                                                                                            *
* The game is still in development, so ignore any errors (^_^')                            *
*                                                                                            *
* Remember to explore all parts of the game, sometimes there are hidden surprises...        *
* Like an 'Easter egg'... waiting to be discovered.                                        *
**********************************************************************************************
SettingsMenu:
**************************************************************************
*                                 Settings:                              *
*                                                                        *
* - Press 1 to change color.                                               *
* - Press 2 to toggle music.                                               *
* - Press 3 to change number of players.                                    *
* - Press 4 to change language.                                            *
* - Press 5 to change difficulty.                                          *
* - Press any other key to return to the main menu.                           *
* - There might be something 'hidden' somewhere...                           *
**************************************************************************
